# Test paths that Backend CI runs a second time with CLICKHOUSE_HOGQL_USE_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA=true,
# against the native-JSON events table. The leg runs wherever the legacy tests run. A run of the
# full legacy matrix (the merge queue, the hourly master run, a PR the selector cannot narrow)
# takes every path. A narrowed PR run takes the paths its test selection reaches, plus the paths
# of the products whose tests it runs. A change to products alone takes those products' paths.
# The test-new-events-schema label doubles the backend suites. Listed paths those suites
# exclude still run here so the label does not reduce native-schema coverage.
#
# A test belongs here when the code it runs can give a different result on the two events tables.
# Three kinds of code can:
#   - code that reads event properties, through HogQL or through its own SQL
#   - code that branches on use_new_events_schema() or settings.CLICKHOUSE_HOGQL_USE_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA
#   - callers of flag_calls_only_in_flag_evaluations() and reads_flag_calls_from_flag_evaluations()
#     in products/feature_flags/backend/facade/flags.py. Both return True on every flag evaluations
#     mode for a team that reads the native JSON events table and has the flag_evaluations table
#     enabled, because the JSON events table holds no flag calls.
# The list also holds the modules that own a *.new_events_schema.ambr snapshot. A module outside
# the list runs against the legacy table only, and its JSON snapshot goes stale. A test that mocks
# the branching code, or sets CLICKHOUSE_HOGQL_USE_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA itself, gets the same result
# on both runs, so it stays off the list.
#
# .github/scripts/check-new-events-schema-targets.py fails a pull request that adds one of those
# branches to a module when a test that imports the module is not listed, unless the pull request
# has the test-new-events-schema label. It does not see a test that reaches the module through
# another module.
#
# One path per line, directory or file, relative to the repository root. A file under a listed
# directory needs no line of its own. Every path must hold at least one test module.
#
# posthog/dags/tests/test_data_deletion_requests.py stays out because it calls the JSONDropKeys
# UDF, which the ClickHouse config of the Django test job does not define.

# HogQL, its query runners, and the ClickHouse layer below them
